context: Naoko and Hiroshi catch up after years apart at a small reunion.
purpose: Older Kansai relatives reconnecting; warm sharp banter.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ほんま久しぶりやな、兄ちゃん!
lines.style: Brassy, uninhibited Kansai warmth. Sharp attack on the greeting. Loud and joyous, the voice of someone who fills a room. Genuine delight underneath the volume.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Gravelly, measured Kansai elder. Slow opening. Warm and fond, the kind of voice that carries decades of family. Gentle settling into the moment.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 年寄りばっかり言うな!
lines.en: Don't you start calling me old!
lines.style: Sharp Kansai sharpness with no bite. Quick, mock-indignant attack. Loud enough to fill the space but playing — the rhythm of a familiar argument she loves having.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Soft chuckle woven into the words. Slow delivery, almost a sigh of affection. Amusement that comes from knowing someone deeply and liking what you know.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 昔の話、酒飲みながらしよか。
lines.en: Come on — let's dig into the old stories over a drink.
lines.style: Bright, inviting Kansai lilt. Energetic but not rushed. The tone of someone extending an arm, making space, settling in. Warm expectation of yes.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: Yeah, sounds good — let's have one.
lines.style: Gentle agreement, unhurried. Slow warm nod in voice form. The elder allowing himself to be drawn in, settling into the ritual. Comfort in the familiar pattern.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.style: Explosive Kansai energy. Sharp bright attack, full-voiced. The sound of someone gathering momentum. Pure cheerful momentum carrying everyone forward.
